inputs.commit_message: export verified ASOL stage 2 generated files
inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail
root=/home/hesham/gova
branch=agent-request/chatgpt
tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/asol-stage2-export-XXXXXX)
cleanup() { git -C "$root" worktree remove --force "$tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || rm -rf "$tmp"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
git -C "$root" fetch origin "$branch"
remote_sha=$(git -C "$root" rev-parse "origin/$branch")
git -C "$root" worktree add --detach "$tmp" "$remote_sha"
ln -s "$root/node_modules" "$tmp/node_modules"
cd "$tmp"
rm -rf .agent-control/requests
npm run docs:generate >/dev/null
for file in $(git diff --name-only -- docs/09-agent-knowledge/generated); do
  echo "ASOL_FILE_BEGIN:$file"
  base64 -w0 "$file"
  echo
  echo "ASOL_FILE_END:$file"
done
echo ASOL_STAGE2_EXPORT=PASS
